thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Metering anomaly detected: token counts from emitter-agg diverging from billing-aggregator by ~+38% starting at 2024-07-01T00:02Z. Auto-pager to #incidents.
carla: ACK, oncall pinged. I see spike in emitter-agg logs around 00:01.
ben: Seeing overage flags firing for a small customer subset — two accounts so far. Holding on notifying customers until we know root cause.
matt: I rolled a small emitter deploy at 23:59 to change batching behavior (PR 4321). Could be related.
dan: Customer Success — please update me if customer-facing alerts needed.
carla: Matt — can you confirm which commit and whether we changed sampling or tokenization?
matt: commit 9f3b7c — only batching/regrouping, no tokenization changes. Deployed canary to us-east then rolled.
carla: Running quick checks: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server pk:9092 --describe --group emitter-agg` shows consumer lag normal.
carla: Checking emitter-agg logs for repeated re-emit or duplicate messages. grep shows repeated acks around 00:01 from service `emitter-proxy` — snippet: ```2024-07-01T00:01:03Z emitter-proxy INFO requeued 127 messages for topic usage.v1 id=abc123```
ben: Billing-aggregator reports token counts lower; looks like emitter-agg double-counted tokens before the aggregator dedupe step. If emitter requeued/resent messages, aggregator may not have dedupe id.
matt: That log matches a transient SQS/Kafka backoff we introduced — backoff handler requeued payloads without preserving dedupe-id header in 9f3b7c. Oops.
carla: Mitigation plan: 1) temporary disable overage alerts (Ben) 2) patch emitter to preserve dedupe header and redeploy canary (Matt) 3) run quick dedupe backfill for last 30m (me + Ben) 4) notify CS with ETA (Dan).
ben: I'll mute alert rule `billing.overage.customer-flags` for 30m and note in PagerDuty incident.
dan: I'll draft a short note: "We’re investigating elevated usage flags; small number of customers affected, working on remediation. No billing changes yet."
matt: Pushing hotfix `preserve-dedupe-headers` to canary now. Deploy command: `kubectl set image deployment/emitter proxy=registry/redwood/emitter:9f3b7c-hotfix`
ops-bot: Deploy started for emitter/canary 9f3b7c-hotfix — rollout status: 0/3 ready.
carla: While deploy runs, I'm preparing backfill query: `SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE ts >= '2024-07-01T00:00Z' GROUP BY account_id HAVING SUM(tokens) > 0;` will diff against billing ledger.
ben: Run caution: backfill should be idempotent — we'll mark applied backfill batch id. I'll coordinate to avoid double-applying.
ops-bot: Canary rollout complete: 3/3 ready.
matt: Hotfix live on canary and auto-promoted to stable. I added header passthrough test to CI.
carla: Backfill diff shows ~+42% extra tokens in emitter-agg window for two accounts: acct-42 and acct-314. Suggest we mark those events as duplicates and reconcile ledger.
ben: I'll schedule an emergency job to reconcile those two accounts and rollback the flagged overages. ETA ~25min.
dan: Notifying CS: "Mitigation underway, expected reconciliation within 30 minutes. We’ll follow up once counts are corrected."
carla: Closing loop: root cause = emitter requeue path that removed dedupe header introduced in recent change. Action items: matt (revert/patch + CI test), ben (reconcile ledger + unflag customers), carla (postmortem with timeline), dan (customer comms).
matt: Filed follow-up PR 4330 with tests.
ben: Reconciliation job completed — flags cleared for acct-42 and acct-314. No charge changes applied; we will not bill for duplicates.
dan: CS notified customers and will follow up with affected teams.
carla: Incident resolved. Putting together postmortem draft.
incident-bot: Incident closed (severity: P2) — postmortem requested.
